description: Standard Vite/Lovable React SPA with no error boundary anywhere: main.tsx calls createRoot, App.tsx holds providers and routes. VC036 should fire on App.tsx but only fires when App.tsx itself calls createRoot/ReactDOM.render, which no Vite or CRA scaffold does. Known gap: where the boundary lives (main.tsx, App.tsx or a router errorElement) is a cross-file question a per-file rule cannot answer without false positives.
